subject: p-fc
title: (R)P.FC.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 321 (R(AS)CM(I)-5). P-FC (particular focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From LANG-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AF-NT: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From VT-PLT: RH-CONT-DY. From RH-CONT-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment).
